pass_bar.description: Deployed tabular estimator LOPO MAE at least 15% below dummy LOPO, R² > 0, n_studies >= 15. Ridge is reported but not served. Shrinkage is empirical Bayes (kernel + material prior), not a neural net.

notes: This is the MVP scientific metric on hand-curated live/dead only. Simulated holdout R² is not.
Auto-promoted pmid* rows are excluded from this split.
Do not add unpaired regex hits to inflate n_rows.
Deployed estimator is the LOPO winner among dummy, material-class mean, and shrinkage. Ridge overfits this table.
